verdict.rationale: The evidence shows organization-wide secret detection and prevention, and push protection that blocks pushes containing active secrets, which is one narrow form of policy enforcement. GitHub Actions is documented as a CI/CD and workflow automation platform, but nothing shows CI/CD policies or coding standards being enforced centrally across all teams and repositories. missing for 10: org-wide rulesets or branch protection, required status checks or workflows across repos, centrally enforced coding standards or linting policies, enterprise-level CI/CD policy controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
